# Homepage asset sources

Crimson Pro and Ubuntu Mono are the original Google Fonts, served locally without modifying their binaries. Font Awesome 6.4.2 SVG icons retain their original license comments. Google Scholar and CV use the original Academicons 1.8.6 glyph outlines; their coordinate transform converts font coordinates to SVG coordinates. Licenses and attribution are included in this directory.

Font stylesheet sources:
- https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Crimson+Pro:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,500;1,600&display=swap
- https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ubuntu+Mono&display=swap
